name: Interactive Brokers
description: Interactive Brokers is a highly automated global broker: clients (individual investors, hedge funds, advisors, prop-trading firms, introducing brokers) trade stocks, options, futures, forex, bonds and forecast contracts on more than 170 exchanges in 40 countries, and IBKR custodies the accounts. It reports a single segment. The larger half of net revenue is not trading commissions but net interest: it earns interest on customer margin loans and on customer cash held in segregated accounts and pays customers less on credit balances. The public company owns only about 26 percent of the operating entity, so of $4,357M total net income only $984M belongs to common stockholders; the rest goes to the founder's holding company as non-controlling interests. It has wound down market making (principal trading is now small) and pays a small quarterly dividend.

businessLines.name: Net interest income
businessLines.how: IBKR lends to customers on margin and invests segregated customer cash in short-term government securities, paying customers a lower rate on credit balances; revenue follows benchmark rates and customer balances (average customer credit balances rose $29.6B, margin loans $16.5B, segregated cash $15.1B in 2025, while yields fell with rates).

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net of interest expense

businessLines.name: Commissions
businessLines.how: Customers pay a commission per order or per share/contract (average $2.68 per cleared commissionable order in 2025, down 6 percent); volumes: 4,399 thousand accounts (+32 percent), 3,685 thousand customer daily average revenue trades (+40 percent).

businessLines.name: Other fees and services, and other income
businessLines.how: Market-data and account fees, payments for order flow and similar, and gains (including from principal trading, currency and investments); other income rose from $60M to $202M in 2025.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31) ($291M fees and services plus $202M other income)

businessLines.name: Brokerage (the single reported segment)
businessLines.how: Execution, clearing, settlement and custody for clients globally plus margin and securities lending; unusually low costs (non-interest expenses $1,434M, 23 percent of net revenue) because order routing, onboarding and processing are automated.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), income before income taxes

brands.name: IBKR Pro / IBKR Lite
brands.note: two pricing tiers; Lite customers do not use IB SmartRouting; split not reported

brands.name: IBG LLC (operating holding company; IBG, Inc. owns about 26.3 percent at 2025-12-31, 26.5 percent at 2026-06-30)
brands.note: The rest is held by IBG Holdings (founder-controlled); it takes about 77 percent of net income as non-controlling interest.
